description: This PHP source file defines the UserTransformer class, which transforms User model instances into array representations, providing methods to retrieve user-related information such as avatar, fullname, email, project names, roles, and profile links within the Goteo project.

classes.name: UserTransformer
classes.description: A class responsible for transforming User model data into a specific array format, including methods for fetching user profile details, roles, avatar, and profile links.

methods.name: getAvatar
methods.description: Returns the user's avatar link at 64x64 size if available, otherwise empty string.

methods.name: getFullname
methods.description: Returns the full name of the user, aliasing the getName method (possibly inherited).

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Retrieves the email address of the user.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Returns the user's amount as an integer.

methods.name: getProjects
methods.description: Retrieves the project names associated with the user.

methods.name: getRoles
methods.description: Retrieves the user's roles and adds 'owner' role if the user has projects.

methods.name: getLink
methods.description: Generates a profile link URL, either in admin or public context.
